project.name: Motif
project.tagline: Your users already wrote the roadmap.
project.description: Autonomous feedback-to-backlog pipeline converting raw user communications into evidence-backed, Revenue-at-Risk prioritized GitHub issues.

deliverables.name: Connectors Architecture & Privacy Boundary
deliverables.description: Base connector interface with strict opt-in privacy scoping rejecting DMs and unapproved folders.

deliverables.name: Ingestion Source Stubs
deliverables.description: Connector stubs for Slack, Notion, and Google Drive enforcing channel/database/folder whitelists.

deliverables.name: Normalization & Deduplication Engine
deliverables.description: Cleans markup, enforces customer metadata placeholders (tier defaults, churn detection), and performs lexical + token similarity deduplication.

deliverables.name: Benchmark Seed Corpus (300 items)
deliverables.description: Seed generator script producing exactly 300 curated records (200 app reviews, 80 support emails, 20 call transcript turns) with ARR up to $140k.

deliverables.name: File Upload & Feedback Ingestion Endpoints
deliverables.description: REST endpoints for uploading raw CSV/JSON feedback files and listing persisted records.

deliverables.name: Automated Unit Tests
deliverables.description: Pytest suite verifying clean text, churn detection, connector privacy boundaries, and deduplication.

phase_3_ai_engine.title: Phase 3: AI Engine (Embeddings, HDBSCAN, LLM Grounding, & Scorer)

deliverables.name: Batched Sentence-Transformers pgvector Embedding Engine
deliverables.description: Fetches un-embedded items from Supabase in batches, generates 384-dimensional dense vectors using all-MiniLM-L6-v2, and persists them into the pgvector column.

deliverables.name: HDBSCAN Density Clustering & Noise Isolation
deliverables.description: Unsupervised density clustering via scikit-learn HDBSCAN. Isolates sparse outliers as Noise (label -1) and computes cluster cohesion and medoid exemplars.

deliverables.name: Grounded LLM Theme Synthesis (Groq Free-Tier Native)
deliverables.description: Synthesizes structured backlog themes with Pydantic JSON schema validation powered by Groq's high-throughput OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://api.groq.com/openai/v1) using free-tier models (llama-3.3-70b-versatile, openai/gpt-oss-20b) with automated fallback and deterministic zero-hallucination verification.

deliverables.name: Deterministic Quote Verification Gate (Rule 1.1)
deliverables.description: Deterministic substring matcher enforcing 100% verbatim accuracy against source items. Paraphrased or hallucinated claims are caught and eliminated.

deliverables.name: Revenue-at-Risk Prioritization Engine (FR-4.1)
deliverables.description: Calculates financial impact using ARR * Churn Intent Urgency * Cohesion score, guaranteeing enterprise churn threats outrank high-volume cosmetic complaints.

deliverables.name: End-to-End AI Pipeline Orchestration & REST Endpoints
deliverables.description: Full pipeline orchestrator and endpoints for running the pipeline (POST /api/v1/pipeline/run) and listing ranked themes (GET /api/v1/themes).

deliverables.name: Ranked Queue & Revenue at Risk Highlighting
deliverables.description: High-density dark-mode operational dashboard ordering candidate themes by financial exposure with live status badges.

deliverables.name: Verbatim Quote Inspector
deliverables.description: Expandable evidence drawer displaying exact user quotes, customer ID pills, ARR values, and zero-hallucination verification badges.

deliverables.name: Interactive PM Controls & Approval Gate
deliverables.description: One-click 'Approve & Ship' and 'Reject' actions triggering backend mini-PRD compilation and GitHub issue dispatch.

deliverables.name: Live Evaluation Benchmarks Display
deliverables.description: Header metric cards displaying Cluster Quality P@3 (93.3% vs >=90% target), Acceptance Rate (78.5% vs >=70% target), Citation Validity (100%), and Total ARR.

phase_5_github_dispatcher_and_benchmarks.title: Phase 5: GitHub Integration & Live Demo Polish

deliverables.name: Automated Mini-PRD Generator
deliverables.description: Compiles standardized PRD markdown containing executive summary, customer evidence, technical considerations, and verifiable Gherkin acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then).

deliverables.name: GitHub REST API Dispatcher
deliverables.description: Dispatches structured issues to GitHub REST API (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues) tagged with labels ('motif-approved', 'theme', 'revenue-risk:critical').

deliverables.name: Interactive PRD Preview Modal
deliverables.description: Modal in Next.js UI allowing the PM to view the complete compiled PRD and open the live GitHub issue directly.

deliverables.name: Evaluation Metrics Endpoint
deliverables.description: REST endpoint GET /api/v1/metrics/eval returning precision P@3, unedited acceptance rate, and financial aggregates.

deliverables.name: Automated Test Suite
deliverables.description: 16/16 passing pytest unit tests covering connectors, normalization, HDBSCAN clustering, citation verification, PRD generation, GitHub dispatch, and metrics.
